_doc: Player robot samples in the approved Toybox direction: straight front view, symmetric, feet at the bottom edge, transparent; generated at 48x48 and padded bottom-centre to the in-game 50x50. Not wired into the game (the player sheet's death/drown frames must be redrawn to match first). See docs/art/classes/characters.md and docs/art/PIPELINE.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

shared.robotSubject: Subject: the player robot of a programming puzzle game: a small cute toy robot standing upright, straight front view, facing the viewer, flat 2D, like a character standing upright seen from the front, not isometric. Perfectly symmetric left and right. A big square cream head with rounded corners and a wide sky-blue visor with two friendly round eyes and a small smile, a short antenna with a yellow ball on top; a boxy tomato-red body with a cream chest panel; two short arms hanging at its sides ending in grey claw hands; two short grey legs with chunky red feet resting on the bottom edge of the canvas. Centered, fills the canvas height, transparent background.

defaults.negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, tracks, wheels
